passage: Protect What Matters with Irongate Security Services. For over fifteen years, Irongate has safeguarded homes and businesses across the Delmont region. Our residential packages start at just $29 per month and include door and window sensors, a smart control panel, and 24-hour professional monitoring from our local response center — never an overseas call center. Add high-definition outdoor cameras, smoke and carbon monoxide detection, or smart door locks at any time. For businesses, we design customized systems featuring access-control badges, motion-activated lighting, and after-hours patrol checks. This autumn, new residential customers who sign a 24-month monitoring agreement receive free standard installation, a savings of $199. The offer ends November 30 and cannot be combined with other promotions; a one-time activation fee of $49 still applies, and customers who cancel within the first year are responsible for 75 percent of the remaining contract balance. Renters welcome — our wireless equipment installs without drilling and moves with you. Schedule a free, no-obligation security assessment at www.irongatesecurity.com or call 555-0114 today.

questions.question: What is emphasized about Irongate's monitoring service?
options: It is handled by a local response center.
It is free for the first two years.
It operates only during business hours.
It is available exclusively to homeowners.
questions.explanation: '24-hour professional monitoring from our local response center — never an overseas call center'라는 표현에서 해외 콜센터가 아닌 지역 대응 센터에서 관제한다는 점을 강조하고 있습니다. 정답은 (A)입니다. 24시간 운영되므로 (C)는 오답이고, 세입자도 환영한다고 했으므로 (D)도 오답입니다.

questions.question: How can new customers receive free installation?
options: By paying the activation fee in advance
By signing a two-year monitoring agreement
By purchasing outdoor cameras
By referring another customer
questions.explanation: 'new residential customers who sign a 24-month monitoring agreement receive free standard installation'이라고 했으므로 24개월(2년) 관제 계약을 체결하면 $199 상당의 표준 설치가 무료입니다. 정답은 (B)입니다.

questions.question: What is indicated about the autumn promotion?
options: It waives the activation fee.
It can be combined with other offers.
It is available until the end of November.
It applies to business customers only.
questions.explanation: 'The offer ends November 30'이라고 명시했으므로 프로모션은 11월 말까지 유효합니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. $49의 활성화 수수료는 여전히 부과되므로('a one-time activation fee of $49 still applies') (A)는 오답이고, 다른 프로모션과 중복 불가('cannot be combined')이므로 (B)도 오답이며, 신규 주거용(residential) 고객 대상이므로 (D)도 오답입니다.

questions.question: What is suggested about Irongate's wireless equipment?

It requires professional drilling to install.
It must be returned when a contract ends.
It is available for businesses only.

passage: www.irongatesecurity.com/careers --- Security Patrol Officer (Night Shift) — Delmont Area. Irongate Security Services is expanding its commercial patrol division and seeks three patrol officers for the night shift, 10:00 P.M. to 6:00 A.M., four nights per week on a rotating schedule. Officers drive marked company vehicles along assigned routes, conduct exterior and interior checks of client properties, respond to alarm activations, and write incident reports using a tablet-based system. Applicants must be at least 21 years old, hold a valid driver's license with a clean three-year record, and possess a current provincial security guard license. Candidates without the license may still apply: Irongate will sponsor qualified applicants through the 40-hour certification course, with the $300 course fee deducted in installments from their first six paychecks. Starting pay is $24.50 per hour, with a $1.50 night-shift premium and full dental coverage after the 90-day probationary period. Note that this position requires passing a physical fitness evaluation and a drug screening; offers are conditional until both are complete. Submit applications through this page by January 19. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

questions.question: What will the patrol officers be responsible for?

Installing security cameras at client sites
Inspecting client properties and writing reports
Training new security dispatchers
questions.explanation: 직무 설명에 'conduct exterior and interior checks of client properties ... and write incident reports'가 포함되어 있으므로, 고객 건물 내외부 점검과 사건 보고서 작성이 주요 업무입니다. 정답은 (C)입니다. 콜센터 관제, 카메라 설치, 신입 교육은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: What does Irongate offer applicants who lack a security guard license?
options: A reduced probationary period
Sponsorship through a certification course
A free 40-hour driving course
An exemption from the licensing requirement
questions.explanation: 'Irongate will sponsor qualified applicants through the 40-hour certification course, with the $300 course fee deducted in installments from their first six paychecks'라고 했으므로, 자격증이 없는 지원자에게는 40시간 인증 과정 수강을 지원하되 수강료 $300는 첫 6번의 급여에서 분할 공제합니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 비용이 급여에서 공제되므로 완전 무료는 아니며, 요건 면제도 아닙니다.

questions.question: What is NOT listed as a requirement for the position?
options: Being at least 21 years of age
Having a clean driving record
Passing a physical fitness evaluation
Having two years of patrol experience
questions.explanation: 21세 이상, 3년간 무사고 운전 경력('a clean three-year record'), 체력 평가 통과는 모두 요건으로 명시되어 있습니다. 그러나 순찰 경력 2년은 언급되지 않았으므로 정답은 (D)입니다. 자격증이 없어도 지원 가능하다고 했듯이 경력 요건은 제시되지 않았습니다.

questions.question: When do employees become eligible for dental coverage?
options: Immediately upon hiring
After completing the 90-day probationary period
After six paychecks
After one full year of employment
questions.explanation: 'full dental coverage after the 90-day probationary period'라고 했으므로 90일의 수습 기간을 마친 후에 치과 보험 혜택을 받을 수 있습니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 6번의 급여는 자격증 과정 수강료 분할 공제와 관련된 내용입니다.

passage: Teach With Us! Harmony House Music School Is Hiring Instructors. Due to record enrollment, Harmony House Music School is seeking part-time instructors of guitar, voice, and drums for the upcoming fall term. Instructors teach private lessons of 30 to 60 minutes and may also lead one weekly group ensemble class. Evening and Saturday availability is required; Sunday availability is a plus, as we are considering weekend expansion. Candidates invited to interview will be asked to give a 15-minute demonstration lesson with a current student. Send a résumé and a short video introduction to hiring@harmonyhousemusic.com by August 8. Incomplete submissions will not be considered.

questions.question: Why is the school hiring new instructors?
options: Several teachers recently retired.
Student enrollment has reached a record level.
A second campus is opening downtown.
The school is adding orchestra classes.
questions.explanation: 'Due to record enrollment'이라는 표현에서 등록 학생 수가 사상 최고치를 기록하여 강사를 충원한다는 것을 알 수 있습니다. 정답은 (B)입니다. 교사 은퇴, 분교 개설, 오케스트라 수업 신설은 언급되지 않았습니다(주말 확장은 '검토 중'일 뿐입니다).

questions.question: What qualification can substitute for a music degree?
options: A teaching license from any subject area
Three years of professional teaching or performance experience
Completion of a 15-minute demonstration lesson
Previous employment at a music store

Copies of music diplomas
questions.explanation: 'Send a résumé and a short video introduction to hiring@harmonyhousemusic.com by August 8. Incomplete submissions will not be considered'라고 했으므로 이력서와 짧은 자기소개 영상을 함께 제출해야 하며, 빠진 것이 있으면 검토되지 않습니다. 정답은 (C)입니다.
